selection_process: Candidates will be required to qualify the following stages:
English Shorthand Test at 80 W.P.M. and Transcription at 20 W.P.M. on computer. A Computer Proficiency Test (CPT)
The Stenography/Shorthand test is scheduled to be held on 28.09.2026
and the Computer Proficiency Test on 05.10.2026. Candidates must bring their original documents and valid ID proof at the time of the test. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the test.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format. Interested and eligible candidates can follow these steps:
Visit the official website of District Courts, Rewari: https://rewari.dcourts.gov.in/notice-category/recruitments/
Download the application form prescribed for the post of Stenographer Grade III (Ad-hoc Basis).

Fill in all required details, including full name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, gender, educational qualifications, reservation category (if any), contact number, email address, permanent and correspondence address, and relevant work experience.
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph at the top of the form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.
Superscribe the envelope clearly as "Post Applied For Stenographer Grade III (Adhoc)".
Send the completed application to: The District and Sessions Judge, District Court Complex, Rewari.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 17.09.2026, up to 5:00 P.M.
Candidates already employed in any Government/Semi-Government Department, Board, or Corporation on an ad-hoc basis must submit their applications through the proper channel.
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete, without photographs, missing required documents, or received after the last date shall be rejected without prior notice. Applications received after the deadline of 17.09.2026, including those delayed due to postal or other reasons, will not be entertained. The number of posts is subject to change depending on administrative requirements at the time of selection. No separate call letters will be issued. All important information will be displayed on the notice board of the office and on the official website. Candidates must bring their original documents and valid ID proof at the time of the test. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the test. The decision of the Selection Committee regarding eligibility, selection criteria, and acceptance/rejection of applications shall be final and binding. No advance copy of the application shall be entertained. The final result will be published on the official website of the Sessions Division, Rewari.
